name: Chang International Circuit
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Full Grand Prix circuit, 12 turns (7 right, 5 left), clockwise; not the 3.126 km D circuit

start_finish.source: Approximate: middle of the pit straight in front of the pit building (garages under the main grandstand, racingcircuits.info), located in the Sentinel-2 L2A scene S2B_48PTB_20260412 (10 m); no OSM start/finish tag exists and 10 m imagery cannot show the grid

width.status: Published width; no open imagery fine enough to measure edges
